name: event-time-fieldset
title: Event time fieldset
description: When does it happen: start and end date and time, an All day switch, and an end that moves with the start so the length is kept.
docs: value is { start, end, allDay }: start and end are wall-clock text, "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm" (or "" while nothing is chosen), read in timeZone, so the same value means the same on every machine; convert to an instant with the zone when you save. Moving the start moves the end by the same amount, so a one-hour meeting stays one hour, and a start picked with no end yet gets an hour. An end at or before the start (a later day for all-day events, on or after the first) is refused with the reason in words, in an alert, and the old end stays; it is not reported. All day hides the times and keeps them, so turning it off brings them back. A sentence in a polite live region says the whole event: "Tue 27 Oct, 14:00 to 15:00 (1 h), Europe/Amsterdam". minuteStep sets the times in the list, minDate ("YYYY-MM-DD") the first day, locale the language of the dates. The pickers are the house Date picker and Time picker; start and end are each a group named "Starts" and "Ends", inside a fieldset with a legend. labels renames every word.
